name: io.github.philsalesses/ans
description: ANS: receipts and trust for agent work. Register, verify agents, open and seal Job Receipts, publish typed offers, invoke them with escrowed credit.
title: ANS

environmentVariables.name: ANS_CREDENTIALS
environmentVariables.description: Path to the credentials file written by `npx -y ans-mcp register`. Default ~/.config/ans/credentials.json. With no file present the server starts with ans_register plus the read-only tools.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer ak_... API key from registration (`npx -y ans-mcp register`) or the Keys panel at https://ans-registry.org/manage. Without it the server exposes read-only tools plus ans_register.
